title: fs-dir: header and settings
description: Add wolfp11/wp11_backend_fs_dir.h (public API: init/finalize/ops struct) and wolfp11/wp11_settings.h additions: WOLFP11_CFG_FS_DIR_PATH default path ("/etc/wolfp11/keys"), compile-time range/sanity checks, and WOLFP11_CFG_FS_DIR_BACKEND guard. No C source yet.
